classes.name: HEAD
classes.guideline: ISUOG Head Biometry Standard: Midline echo with symmetric thalami and cavum septi pellucidi visible.

classes.name: ABDOMEN
classes.guideline: ISUOG Abdominal Biometry Standard: Circular cross-section with stomach bubble, umbilical vein J-shape, no kidneys.

classes.name: FEMUR
classes.guideline: ISUOG Femur Standard: Full ossified diaphysis with blunt ends, horizontal orientation perpendicular to acoustic beam.

classes.name: OTHER
classes.biometric_plane: Heart / Spine / Face / Placenta / Doppler / Overview
classes.guideline: Scan is clinically useful for anatomical survey or doppler, but does not correspond to standard biometric measurement planes.

classes.name: UNKNOWN
classes.guideline: Classification confidence below threshold (<0.65). Requires clinician visual inspection or probe repositioning.
